pre_condition: work_dir is a path to an existing directory.
post_condition: Returns the set of non-empty check_id strings read from the ignored-checks file under work_dir, where each entry is stripped of leading and trailing whitespace and blank lines are discarded. Returns an empty set when the file does not exist, cannot be read, or yields zero non-empty entries after stripping. The function has no side effects — it does not create, modify, or delete the ignored-checks file or any other file or directory.
